about_the_game:
Chemia is a gripping survival crafting game set in a world ravaged by a catastrophic natural disaster. The air is thick with toxic gases, and the landscape has been forever altered, leaving humanity struggling to adapt. As a lone survivor, you’ll need to gather resources, craft vital equipment, and navigate this hazardous world if you hope to survive.

Game Features:

  • Explore a Dangerous World: The environment is unpredictable, filled with toxic gases, crumbling ruins, and hidden dangers. Each new region you discover presents a unique challenge, requiring you to think on your feet to survive.

  • The Train: Your Safe Haven: Your train is your lifeline—a mobile base where you can craft, smelt, and upgrade your gear. It’s a safe zone in a world that constantly wants to kill you, and it also serves as your primary mode of transport as you traverse the wasteland.

  • Deep Crafting System: Gather resources from the world around you to craft protective gear, tools, and advanced machinery. Every item you create could be the difference between life and death, so experiment and find the right combination to keep yourself safe.

  • Toxic Hazards: The world is filled with shifting gas clouds and deadly storms. You’ll need to plan your movements carefully, relying on your train to take shelter and craft between your dangerous expeditions.

  • Strategic Exploration: The landscape is massive, and the dangers are ever-present. As you explore, you’ll unlock new crafting recipes, upgrade your gear, and make critical decisions about where to go and what to bring. Every step counts.

With its blend of exploration, crafting, and survival, Chemia challenges you to master a world that seems determined to wipe out humanity. Can you navigate the toxic wasteland, rebuild your life, and uncover the secrets hidden in the ruins of civilization? The fate of your survival lies in your hands.

short_description: In Chemia, survive a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by disaster. Scavenge vital resources, craft powerful tools, and navigate toxic environments to stay alive. Uncover the mysteries of a shattered world and face ever-evolving dangers in this intense survival crafting adventure.
